skos:definition: For each analyte, records which X-ray detection technique (EDS or WDS) was used to collect the measurement. Required when a protocol employs both EDS and WDS simultaneously, assigning each element to the detector appropriate to its concentration range, line overlap situation, or required precision.

skos:hasTopConcept.skos:prefLabel: Si: WDS; Al: WDS; Fe: WDS; Na: EDS; C: EDS
skos:hasTopConcept.skos:notation: Si: WDS; Al: WDS; Fe: WDS; Na: EDS; C: EDS
